name: Condensed and evaporated milks

iAs.control: Dairy regulations set total-arsenic limits, not a separate inorganic-arsenic limit. Total arsenic is measured on every lot and bounds the iAs fraction; an elevated total-As result triggers arsenic speciation.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; iAs by HPLC-ICP-MS (EN 16802 or equivalent) on an elevated total-As result.

tHg.label: Sovereign general-dairy read-across from Israel's 100 ug/kg total-mercury maximum where the government register has no exact dairy-form row.
tHg.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

MeHg.control: There is no methylmercury bioaccumulation pathway in dairy and no sovereign dairy MeHg maximum. Total mercury is measured on every lot and bounds the methylmercury fraction.
MeHg.reference_method: Total Hg by EPA 7473 or ICP-MS; reflex MeHg speciation only if total Hg approaches the category ceiling.

Ni.label: Conservative sovereign dairy read-across from the EU liquid infant/young-child formula nickel maximum (100 ug/kg) where no general-dairy nickel maximum exists.
Ni.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Sn.control: Tin is a packaging-migration analyte. Non-tinplate dairy products have no intrinsic tin pathway; products in tin-coated containers instead use the directly applicable canned/tin-coated dairy limit.
Sn.reference_method: Packaging declaration plus total Sn by ICP-MS; route tin-coated packs to the canned/tin-coated limit.

Al.label: Conservative sovereign dairy read-across from the AU-NZ non-soy infant-formula aluminium maximum (500 ug/kg); no general-dairy aluminium maximum is loaded.
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr.label: China GB 2762 total-chromium maximum for liquid milk (300 ug/kg), directly applicable to liquid/fermented milk and used as a disclosed dairy-matrix read-across for other non-powder dairy products.
Cr.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr-VI.control: Total chromium is measured on every lot. Any total-Cr result at or above 100 ug/kg triggers Cr(VI) speciation, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; Cr(VI) by EPA 3060A with IC-ICP-MS / EN 15192 or equivalent.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
